notes: The prompt says tactical shooter, which points at the MilSim preset and its rooms-sequence raid site, but the goal answer overrides that outright: bomb defusal, clear lanes, two objective sites, 5v5. That is the Bomb Defusal preset on the genre-default lane-network, with capture-zone carrying the two bomb sites, choke-bottleneck the lane pinches, cover-los the arrays along each lane, and spawn-teambase the two shielded ends. settlement-density was added because the theme answer asks for dense urban streets rather than scattered buildings, and the war damage bends the wording of the map and its cover rather than adding a row. Without a user I left interiors out — a compact round-based defusal map plays through streets and doorways and nothing said players clear buildings, so this stays on P0; enterable damaged buildings would need the outside-inside transition pass, which is worth raising as an upgrade. The two bomb sites are the only stated count and are recorded here.
